# NH Reader v0.7.5

**Release date:** 2026-10-07
**Version Type:** Semantic Versioning

## ✨ Highlights

NH Reader v0.7.5 is a tooling and installer-polish release providing prebuilt desktop installers for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The Windows installer drops the cramped header banner so the Welcome and Finish pages present the sidebar branding cleanly on the stock NSIS/MUI palette, resolving the dark-on-dark finish-page text issue from v0.7.4.

For developers and local builders, a single opt-in signing command (`npm run sign`) detects the host OS, discovers built artifacts, signs with native tooling, and verifies every signature—with automatic Apple notarization and stapling when credentials are set. Mobile builds (Android/iOS) and code signing remain local-only tasks and are skipped during automated CI distribution.

## 🚀 Key Improvements & Features

- **Prebuilt Desktop Release Packages** — Automated release workflows build and attach prepackaged installers for Windows (`.exe` NSIS and `.msi`), macOS (Universal binary `.dmg` for Apple Silicon & Intel), and Linux (`.deb` and `.AppImage`).
- **One Sign Command for Local Builds** — `npm run sign` (`scripts/sign.mjs`) discovers built artifacts, signs with `signtool`, `codesign`, `gpg`, `apksigner`, or `xcodebuild`, and verifies signatures. Signing remains strictly opt-in and is skipped during automated CI distribution.
- **Cleaner Windows Installer Pages** — The `headerImage` setting and `header.bmp` were retired in favor of the custom `sidebar.bmp` graphic on a readable system palette.

## ✅ Changed

- **Script Standardization** — Consolidated npm scripts under `tauri:*` (`tauri:dev`, `tauri:build:release`, `tauri:build:debug`, `tauri:android:*`, `tauri:ios:*`) and `check:*` (`check:i18n`, `check`).
- **Retired Legacy Scripts** — Retired `scripts/sign.ps1` in favor of the cross-platform Node.js signing orchestrator `scripts/sign.mjs`.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Dark-on-dark Finish Page Text** — Restored stock NSIS/MUI palette so titles, descriptions, and checkbox labels render legibly across Windows installations.

## 🔍 Platform / Compatibility Matrix

- **Windows**: Windows 10 (1809+) & Windows 11 (x64, arm64). Built as `.msi` (WiX) and `.exe` (NSIS).
- **macOS**: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later. Built as universal binary `.dmg` (Apple Silicon `aarch64` & Intel `x86_64`).
- **Linux**: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 38+, Arch Linux, and modern systemd/glibc desktop distributions with WebKitGTK 4.1. Built as `.deb` and `.AppImage`.
- **Mobile (Android / iOS)**: Built locally via `npm run tauri:android:build` / `npm run tauri:ios:build`; not included in automated release packages.

## 🛠️ Build, Installation & Verification

### Local Build & Signing (Optional)

```bash
npm ci
npm run build
npm run tauri:build:release

# Optional local code signing:
npm run sign
```

### Verification Results
- **Rust unit tests**: `cargo test` passed (7/7 tests, 0 failures).
- **TypeScript & Svelte diagnostics**: `npm run check` passed with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
- **Internationalization check**: `npm run check:i18n` verified 279/279 keys across all 17 community packs.
